info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create P2m Refund-spec
info.description: The P2M Refund Processing API allows businesses to efficiently manage refund transactions for peer-to-peer money transfers. This API enables users to initiate refund requests and handle the necessary transactional adjustments seamlessly. It is particularly valuable for financial services and e-commerce platforms aiming to provide a responsive customer service experience. Typical consumers include developers working on financial applications that require automated refund processing capabilities.

post.summary: Create a new refund for a transaction.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to initiate a refund for a qualifying transaction, specifying the refund amount and reason. Ensure that the transaction is eligible for a refund before using this endpoint.
